target_cwe.cwe_name: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision
target_cwe.description: The product uses a protection mechanism that relies on the existence or values of an input, but the input can be modified by an untrusted actor in a way that bypasses the protection mechanism.
remediation_steps: Implement comprehensive input validation and sanitization
